body:
A system setting (D-22) that turns Gleam or Rust off on a machine, even when its toolchain is installed.

- When a language is off, its projects behave as if the toolchain were missing (task:da797576d0cfaaac): they show a message on the Workspace page, reads still work, and `submit`, `check` and `test` are refused. The message says the language is turned off in settings.
- The default is on for every language whose toolchain is found.
- Shown on the Settings page.
title: Settings: turn a language off
